name: Marlin Range
tagline: The operating system for the restaurant you run without a dining room.
positioning: Marlin Range unifies menu deployment, delivery-app orchestration, and kitchen throughput so owner-operators can launch new virtual brands in days, not quarters.

hero.h1: Run five restaurants from one kitchen line.
hero.sub: Marlin Range turns a single prep station into a fleet of delivery brands — with unified menus, live order routing, and margin visibility down to the ticket.

features.title: One-tap brand deployment
features.description: Spin up a new virtual concept across DoorDash, Uber Eats, and Grubhub from a single menu source — no re-typing item modifiers into four portals.

features.title: Unified order rail
features.description: Every incoming ticket lands on one expo screen, sequenced by prep time so your line never juggles four tablets during the dinner rush.

features.title: Margin per ticket
features.description: See commission, packaging, and food cost netted out on every order, so you kill unprofitable menu items before they drain a shift.

features.title: Throughput forecasting
features.description: Predict your busiest 30-minute windows by brand and staff the line accordingly, without over-prepping product that ends up in the trash.

features.title: Menu sync engine
features.description: Change a price once and it propagates to every platform and every brand in under a minute, with an audit trail of who changed what.

features.title: Downtime shield
features.description: Auto-pause a brand across all apps the instant a key ingredient runs out, so you stop cancellations before the one-star reviews arrive.

testimonials.quote: We were running three delivery brands off eight tablets and losing tickets nightly. Marlin Range put everything on one rail — our cancellation rate dropped by two thirds in a month.
testimonials.name: Priya Nandakumar

testimonials.quote: The margin-per-ticket view was a wake-up call. We cut four items that were quietly bleeding us and added two seats to cover a new lunch brand. Payback was immediate.
testimonials.name: Marcus Ovalle

testimonials.quote: I launched a wings concept on a Tuesday and it was live across all three platforms by Thursday. That used to take us a month of copy-pasting menus.
testimonials.name: Danielle Boothe

homepage.footerBlurb: Marlin Range is the command center for the delivery-native kitchen. Fewer tablets, tighter margins, more brands per line.
